statement: All 55 numbered systems in the founder-supplied arsenal are mandatory delivery obligations. Each needs real working behavior, a usable integrated GREG/Foundry interface, meaningful tests, and reproducible execution evidence, including limits and recovery. Shared primitives are encouraged; a registry entry alone is not delivery. Deferring preserves the obligation; removal or substitution requires explicit founder approval. First founder-owned mission is an integration milestone, with hardware selected later.
owner: Alfonso Lopez; Kernel and canonical GREG/Foundry maintainers implement
binding_scope: All 55 numbered systems remain in scope for reversible development and draft review; each numbered item needs independent integration evidence. No chat source becomes cryptographic runtime authentication.
constitutional_constraints: one GREG runtime, one Kernel authority plane, one canonical ledger and no duplicate executable learning engines
building does not authorize installation, activation, spending, external contact, publication, deployment or merger
founder retains shutdown and scope authority, with human rights before participant operations
success_evidence: 55 distinct item-level demonstrations of actual integrated behavior with meaningful tests and reproducible evidence, limitations and recovery
failure_evidence: Existing foundry/arsenal.py statuses are selection metadata rather than item-level acceptance
Current FoundryComposer returns non-executing plans; neither that plan nor catalog membership completes an item
dependencies: greg/ body, Kernel Gate and EvidenceLedger, foundry/arsenal.py
founder-owned hardware and legitimate authority for embodied and external milestones
conflicts: Earlier delivery focus on VEPMC is a sequencing rule, not a license to delete remaining numbered requirements
Earlier Mac-specific first-body framing is a candidate hardware path; Alfonso states he owns no Mac and will select hardware later
next_review_trigger: Each numbered system's executable integration review; founder hardware selection for VEPMC; only founder may approve removal/substitution
reality_status: active build obligation; 55/55 completion unproven; no item may pass solely from its catalog status
